description: Windows startup manager for reviewing and controlling auto-start entries
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }
pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }

script: Write-Host 'No Inno Setup uninstaller found; this version may have been installed by the previous extraction-only manifest.'
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "Autorun Organizer uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }

notes: Requires administrator rights. The normal Inno Setup installation runs at system scope, while /DIR keeps the application files in this Scoop version directory.

script: if (-not $match.Success) { throw 'Unable to detect the Autorun Organizer version from the official ChemTable product page.' }

post_install: throw "Expected AutorunOrganizer.exe was not installed at the Scoop app root. Executables found: $($found -join '; ')"
throw "AutorunOrganizer.exe was not installed under the Scoop app directory: $dir"
